dialogues.name: Tutorial Intro
dialogues.title: THE SERVICE ACCESS
dialogues.speaker: NEURAL LINK
slides: Neural link established. I will guide you through this maintenance access beneath the APEX facility.
The occupiers trust locked networks to keep our world's resources to themselves. Your subnetting knowledge is our way inside.
First, calibrate your movement and camera. Then follow the route beacon to the service entrance.
We will climb floor by floor, open the supply network and disable the APEX core's control over it.
We are reclaiming working infrastructure, not destroying the services people need.
When the monopoly ends, water, power and essential supplies can reach everyone again.

dialogues.name: Tutorial Outro
dialogues.title: THE FIRST BREACH
dialogues.speaker: NEURAL LINK
slides: Movement calibrated. You have reached the service entrance.
The first floor's wire relays are ahead. Restore their connections, bring light back to the room and begin the climb toward APEX.

dialogues.name: Stage 1 Level 1 Intro
dialogues.title: THE SERVICE ENTRANCE
dialogues.speaker: NEURAL LINK
slides: We are inside the lowest service floor of the APEX facility. Beyond these walls, families wait for power while the occupiers keep their reserves lit.
Four IP wire relays feed this sector. Classify each address and repair its connection; every restored relay brings light back to the room.
Open the next-floor route. We are taking back access, one connection at a time.

dialogues.name: Stage 1 Level 2 Security Breach
dialogues.title: SECURITY BREACH
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: LOCATION BREACHED. APEX security has detected our position.
Five exhausted wire repairs created a traceable pattern in the facility network.
We cannot continue from this location.
Falling back to Stage 1 Level 1. Rebuild the breach route and try again.

dialogues.name: Stage 1 Level 1 Security Retreat
dialogues.title: GO DARK
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: APEX noticed our location and its response teams are closing in.
We have to hide in the previous sector until their trace loses our signal.
They now know the route we used to reach Level 2.
We have to go through Stage 1 Level 1 again and rebuild the breach from the beginning.
Move carefully. We cannot let them reacquire us.

dialogues.name: IP Wires Tutorial Opening
dialogues.title: WIRE PATCH
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: This is Lever 01 of 04 in the service entrance.
Match each full IP address on the left to its correct Class connector on the right.
Repair all four wire relays to restore this floor and open the next-level door.
Read the first octet to identify the IP class.
{{highlight:Class A}}: IP ranges from {{highlight:[IP_CLASS_A_FULL]}}
{{highlight:Class B}}: IP ranges from {{highlight:[IP_CLASS_B_FULL]}}
{{highlight:Class C}}: IP ranges from {{highlight:[IP_CLASS_C_FULL]}}
{{highlight:Class D}}: IP ranges from {{highlight:[IP_CLASS_D_FULL]}}
{{highlight:Class E}}: IP ranges from {{highlight:[IP_CLASS_E_FULL]}}

dialogues.name: IP Wires Tutorial Success
dialogues.title: WIRE PATCH
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: Patch stable.
Good work. Lever 01 of 04 is now supplying power again.
Facility lights and equipment are recovering in this sector.
Continue to the next lever until all four are stabilized.
Once all four are fixed, the next-level door will open.
Your HUD is now fully active.
Your {{highlight:Health Bar}} shows your remaining life force. Keep it above zero to stay in the run.
Your streak changes how many points the Health Bar gains or loses.
{{highlight:Win streak: no recovery on wins 1-2. Win 3 restores +12, then +13, +14, up to +15 points.}}
{{highlight:Non-tutorial loss streak: -10, -12, and so on up to -16 points.}}

A normal win or loss resets the opposite streak. Tutorials do not change HP or streaks. A failed campaign run steps you back one quest inside the current level, stopping at its first quest. Every five failed runs of a gameplay, AR offers an optional tutorial.
The {{highlight:Quest Area}} displays your active quest and target tile.
Check it whenever you need to confirm the next objective.
The {{highlight:quest minimap}} shows your position and nearby quest markers.
Use it to identify the direction of the next repair point.
The {{highlight:Distance tab}} tells you how far you are from the active target.
Use it together with the minimap to reach the next lever.

dialogues.name: IP Wires Tutorial Packets Shifted
dialogues.title: PACKET SHIFT
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: Oh no!
APEX defense shifted the packet layout again.
Step back onto Lever 01 when you are ready.
We need this lever online before progressing to the remaining three.

dialogues.name: IP Wires Recovery Reset
dialogues.title: LEVEL INSTABILITY
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: Oh no!
Too many packet errors tripped the APEX rollback circuit.
The rollback destabilized Lever 01 and cut power recovery progress.
Return to Lever 01 and repair it again.
After Lever 01 is stable, I will route you back to the failed lever node.
Remember: all four levers must stay stable to unlock the next-level door.

dialogues.name: IP Wires Harder Tutorial Opening
dialogues.title: ADAPTIVE SECURITY
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: Congratulations, Hacker. Reaching this level means you have mastered the fundamentals of IP classification.
But the deeper we explore, the more aggressively APEX protects its network.
This patch chassis activates a random three to five IP Classes on every board.
A mismatch makes the rejected IP leads re-key themselves, while verified connections remain locked and unchanged.

dialogues.name: IP Wires Harder Tutorial Success
dialogues.title: ADAPTIVE SECURITY
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: Adaptive re-key briefing complete.
Proceed to the strict challenge lever. Classify each changed lead again whenever APEX rejects a patch.

dialogues.name: IP Wires Harder Challenge Success
dialogues.title: STRICT SECURITY
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: Excellent work.
Strict class-wire security is stabilized. Continue to the next quest node.

dialogues.name: Stage 1 Terminal Alpha
dialogues.title: FIELD TERMINAL
dialogues.speaker: APEX NODE
slides: ACCESS DENIED.
The terminal is still offline while this floor's lever network is unstable.
Restore all four levers to recover full power and unlock deeper systems.

dialogues.name: Stage 1 Junction Box Alpha
dialogues.title: JUNCTION BOX
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: A junction box hums behind the panel.
Its feed is linked to the four Level 1 repair levers.
Stabilizing all levers will restore full equipment output.

dialogues.name: Stage 4 Level 1 Intro
dialogues.title: THE SILENCED OFFICES
dialogues.speaker: NEURAL LINK
slides: These offices once coordinated public services. APEX corrupted their address tables so the city's requests could never reach the reserves upstairs.
Repair the five PCs. Catch the required formula variables and recover network addresses, broadcast addresses and usable host ranges.
Every repaired table is a service route we can return to the people when the core's monopoly ends.

dialogues.name: Network Repair Opening
dialogues.title: NETWORK REPAIR
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: This PC is leaking corrupted subnet formula packets.
Formula variables are falling through five data lanes. Move the receptor to catch the variables needed by the active formula.
Network address uses the start of the block.
Broadcast address uses the end of the block.
Viable host IPs sit between network plus one and broadcast minus one.
After catching the correct variables, place them into the formula blanks and submit.

dialogues.name: Network Repair Quest 1 Correction
dialogues.title: REPAIR COACH
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: Pause the data stream.
This first PC is your calibration node. A wrong catch here means we review the subnet edge and keep the same PC active.
Find the block size from the CIDR mask, then identify which block contains the PC IP.
Network Address = Starting Network Address + (Block Size x (Subnet Number - 1)).
Broadcast Address = Base Network Address + (Block Size x Target Subnet) - 1.
Viable hosts run from Network Address + 1 through Broadcast Address - 1.

dialogues.name: Network Repair Rollback
dialogues.title: ROLLBACK CIRCUIT
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: APEX detected corrupted formula variables.
Their rollback circuit reopened PC 01.
Catch and place the correct formula variables at PC 01 again to prove the route table is stable.
After that, the beacon will return you to the PC where the failure happened.

dialogues.name: Network Repair Complete
dialogues.title: NETWORK REPAIR
dialogues.speaker: SYSTEM
slides: All five PCs are routing cleanly.
Every corrupted IP address has been solved from captured formula variables.
Network address, broadcast address, and usable range traces are restored across the subnet.

dialogues.title: THE DISTRIBUTION LOCK
dialogues.speaker: NEURAL LINK
slides: APEX diverts the city's supply traffic through this distribution floor. The network still serves the occupiers while the public conduits stand empty.
Repair the wire relays, then learn the Patch Panel classifier. Read each packet's type before choosing its IP class or default mask.
A clean route lets us climb toward the controls that decide who receives the planet's resources.

dialogues.title: THE ADAPTIVE GRID
dialogues.speaker: NEURAL LINK
slides: The occupiers reinforced this grid after the first shortages sparked resistance. APEX now changes its locks when it detects a bad connection.
Ordinary and harder wire relays share this floor's power supply. Finish both kinds to restore full lighting; Patch Panels guard the links between them.
If a failed breach reopens a repaired wire quest, that part of the room loses power again. Rebuild the route and keep moving upward.

dialogues.title: THE INNER POWER RING
dialogues.speaker: NEURAL LINK
slides: This is the last power ring before the subnet-control wing. APEX keeps it dark so intruders cannot read the machinery carrying our stolen energy.
Use everything you have learned about ordinary wires, adaptive wires and packet classification. Every wire relay contributes to the same lighting recovery.
Restore the ring and reach the next wing. The command core is above us; the people who need this power are below.

dialogues.title: THE SUBNET GATES
dialogues.speaker: NEURAL LINK
slides: APEX divides the facility into private networks, keeping its reservoirs and supply systems beyond public reach. These binary panels guard the first boundaries.
Rebuild each subnet mask with the lamps, then count the network bits to enter its CIDR prefix. The five panels can cross Class A, B and C boundaries.
Understanding the boundary is how we cross it. Break these locks and bring the upper supply network within reach.

dialogues.title: THE CAPACITY CHECKPOINTS
dialogues.speaker: NEURAL LINK
slides: The next checkpoints verify both identity and capacity. APEX will not pass a route unless its subnet layout agrees with the mask that opened the gate.
Solve each Class C CIDR panel, then carry its exact interesting octet into the linked Subnet Simulator. Calculate subnet counts before host capacity.
We need a route that works when the public systems reconnect. Precision here protects the people who will depend on it.

dialogues.title: THE SHIFTING BOUNDARY
dialogues.speaker: NEURAL LINK
slides: APEX has noticed the intrusion. Its adaptive boundary now replaces a subnet mask whenever a submitted lamp pattern or prefix is wrong.
Read the new target after each mistake and recalculate. Only the mask you finally verify can supply the linked Subnet Simulator's reference.
The occupiers built these boundaries to exclude everyone else. We will understand them well enough to open a path through.

dialogues.title: THE LAST MASK LOCKS
dialogues.speaker: NEURAL LINK
slides: These adaptive relays seal the upper edge of the subnet-control wing. Above them are the engines that enforce APEX's resource monopoly.
One wrong answer re-keys the active mask. Rebuild the binary pattern and CIDR prefix from the current target, not the one APEX discarded.
Clear the wing and carry your subnetting knowledge into the containment floors. The climb is getting closer to the core.

dialogues.title: THE RESERVE ENGINES
dialogues.speaker: NEURAL LINK
slides: The facility's engines reserve network capacity for the occupiers while clinics and neighborhoods remain disconnected. We must calculate a bypass that can support real users.
At each Host-Power Reactor, find the smallest h for which 2^h - 2 meets the required usable hosts. Begin with the guided reactor, then stabilize the remaining nodes.
Enough capacity, without waste: that is how we prepare a network meant to serve everyone.

dialogues.title: THE CONTAINMENT FLOOR
dialogues.speaker: NEURAL LINK
slides: APEX isolates stolen reserves behind hostile network segments. Charging through would expose our route to its countermeasures.
Verify host capacity at the first two reactors. Then re-segment the allocated network: classify it, choose borrowed bits, verify usable hosts and secure the route.
Keep the intrusion contained while we move upward. The systems we are reclaiming must survive the breach.

dialogues.title: THE COUNTERMEASURE WING
dialogues.speaker: NEURAL LINK
slides: APEX is defending the supply backbone with capacity locks and isolated segments. Its automated enforcers are protecting the hoard, not the people outside.
Combine Host-Power Reactors with network re-segmentation. At the final training node, Subnet Blaster turns network and broadcast calculations into a way through the defenses.
Defeating an enforcer opens another route. The main APEX command core still waits at the top of the facility.

dialogues.title: THE UPPER TRANSIT SHAFT
dialogues.speaker: NEURAL LINK
slides: The containment wing is behind us. This transit floor carries the cables linking the occupiers' reserves to the upper command network.
Follow the route beacon to the next access point. The offices ahead hold the address tables that keep public services cut off.
We are close enough to restore those links. Keep the mission in sight: resources for the planet, not a privileged few.

dialogues.title: THE FINAL APPROACH
dialogues.speaker: NEURAL LINK
slides: We have reached the approach to the central routing grid. Behind its final gates, APEX decides which branches receive access to the planet's hoarded resources.
Follow the beacon through this floor and prepare to allocate address space in the command sector ahead.
Our goal is to dismantle the system of exclusion while keeping the infrastructure ready for everyone to use.

dialogues.title: THE PUBLIC ROUTE
dialogues.speaker: NEURAL LINK
slides: This routing grid is the last technical barrier to the command core. The occupiers gave themselves every route and left the rest of the planet disconnected.
Use VLSM to give each branch enough host capacity. Allocate the largest demand first, choose aligned network addresses and prevent overlaps.
Once every branch is valid, commit the route table at the core gateway. We are building the connections APEX refused to share.

dialogues.title: THE APEX CROWN
dialogues.speaker: NEURAL LINK
slides: The command crown is in reach. Beneath us are the power rings, supply networks and service routes you fought to reconnect.
Reach the final uplink. Break APEX's control of the facility and release the resources it has kept from the planet.
End the hoarding system. Let the water, energy and essential supplies belong to everyone again.
